import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static final int MAXN = 1 << 20;
    static int n;
    static int[] f_array = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] g_array = new int[MAXN];
    static int[][] p_matrix;
    static int[][] adjacency;
    static int[][] index_map = new int[2][MAXN];
    static int[] reverse_mask = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] match = new int[21];
    static int[][] M_adj;
    static int[] subset1, subset2;
    static int[] left_part1, left_part2, right_part;
    static int count1, count2;
    static int[] perm, indices;
    static int[] temp_mask;
    static int[] mask_indices;
    static int[] reverse_mask_local;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st;

        n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        p_matrix = new int[n][2 * n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                p_matrix[i][j + n] = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
                p_matrix[i][j + n] = (int)((long)p_matrix[i][j + n] * fast_pow(100, MOD - 2) % MOD);
            }
        }

        if (n == 1) {
            System.out.println(p_matrix[0][1]);
            return;
        }

        int half1 = n / 2;
        int half2 = n - half1;

        count1 = 0;
        count2 = 0;
        List<Integer> subset1_list = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> subset2_list = new ArrayList<>();

        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); mask++) {
            if (Integer.bitCount(mask) == half1) {
                index_map[0][mask] = count1++;
                subset1_list.add(mask);
            }
            if (Integer.bitCount(mask) == half2) {
                index_map[1][mask] = count2++;
                subset2_list.add(mask);
            }
        }

        subset1 = new int[subset1_list.size()];
        for (int i = 0; i < subset1_list.size(); i++) subset1[i] = subset1_list.get(i);
        subset2 = new int[subset2_list.size()];
        for (int i = 0; i < subset2_list.size(); i++) subset2[i] = subset2_list.get(i);

        reverse_mask_local = new int[1 << count2];
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)subset2.length; i++) {
            int mask = subset2[i];
            for (int big_mask = 0; big_mask < (1 << count2); big_mask++) {
                if (((big_mask >> i) & 1) != 0) {
                    reverse_mask_local[big_mask] |= (1 << index_map[0][(1 << n) - 1 - mask]);
                }
            }
        }

        left_part1 = new int[half1];
        left_part2 = new int[half2];
        right_part = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            right_part[i] = i + n;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < half1; i++) left_part1[i] = i;
        for (int i = half1; i < n; i++) left_part2[i - half1] = i;

        process(f_array, left_part1, right_part, subset1, index_map[0]);
        process(g_array, left_part2, right_part, subset2, index_map[1]);

        for (int i = 0; i < count1; i++) {
            for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << count1); mask++) {
                if (((mask >> i) & 1) != 0) {
                    f_array[mask] = (f_array[mask] + f_array[mask ^ (1 << i)]) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }

        long answer = 0;
        for (int mask = 1; mask < (1 << count2); mask++) {
            int w = (int)((1 - f_array[(1 << count1) - 1 - reverse_mask_local[mask]] + MOD) % MOD);
            answer = (answer + (long)w * g_array[mask]) % MOD;
        }

        System.out.println(answer);
    }

    static int fast_pow(int base, int exp) {
        int result = 1;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) != 0) result = (int)((long)result * base % MOD);
            base = (int)((long)base * base % MOD);
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    static void process(int[] f, int[] left_nodes, int[] right_nodes, int[] subgraph, int[] idx) {
        int edgesCount = left_nodes.length * right_nodes.length;
        List<int[]> edges = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int x : left_nodes) {
            for (int y : right_nodes) {
                edges.add(new int[]{x, y});
            }
        }

        int totalMasks = 1 << edges.size();
        int[] adjacency_local = new int[21][21]; // assuming max 21 nodes
        for (int[] row : adjacency_local) Arrays.fill(row, 0);

        for (int mask = 0; mask < totalMasks; mask++) {
            int probability = 1;
            int current_mask = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < edges.size(); i++) {
                int[] edge = edges.get(i);
                if (((mask >> i) & 1) != 0) {
                    probability = (int)((long)probability * p_matrix[edge[0]][edge[1]] % MOD);
                    adjacency_local[edge[0]][edge[1]] = 1;
                } else {
                    probability = (int)((long)probability * (MOD + 1 - p_matrix[edge[0]][edge[1]]) % MOD);
                    adjacency_local[edge[0]][edge[1]] = 0;
                }
            }
            for (int gr : subgraph) {
                perm = new int[left_nodes.length];
                for (int i = 0; i < left_nodes.length; i++) perm[i] = left_nodes[i];
                indices = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    if (((gr >> i) & 1) != 0) indices.add(i + n);
                }
                boolean found = false;
                do {
                    boolean valid = true;
                    for (int i = 0; i < perm.length; i++) {
                        if (adjacency_local[perm[i]][indices.get(i)] == 0) {
                            valid = false;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (valid) {
                        found = true;
                        break;
                    }
                } while (nextPermutation(indices));
                if (found) current_mask |= (1 << idx[gr]);
            }
            f[current_mask] = (f[current_mask] + probability) % MOD;
        }
    }

    static boolean nextPermutation(List<Integer> arr) {
        int i = arr.size() - 2;
        while (i >= 0 && arr.get(i) >= arr.get(i + 1)) i--;
        if (i < 0) return false;
        int j = arr.size() - 1;
        while (arr.get(j) <= arr.get(i)) j--;
        Collections.swap(arr, i, j);
        int left = i + 1, right = arr.size() - 1;
        while (left < right) {
            Collections.swap(arr, left, right);
            left++;
            right--;
        }
        return true;
    }
}
